families.role: cultural, social, institutional, place, consumer, and geopolitical research
families.cadence: on source-record commit and monthly audit
families.trigger: new source-backed record, revision, or counter-signal
families.access_basis: pinned repository revision or local source artifact
families.evidence_boundary: Source-led research records with explicit units, limits, counterevidence, and open tests.

families.role: bounded public discussion and creator-signal observatory
families.trigger: new atlas, collection manifest, or approved source snapshot
families.access_basis: pinned repository revision or local source artifact
families.evidence_boundary: Discussion signals are not representative prevalence, causality, market size, or buying intent.

families.role: public-signal, consumer-trend, theme, subtheme, and counter-signal synthesis
families.trigger: new deep-trend synthesis, falsifier, or input checksum set
families.access_basis: pinned repository revision or local source artifact
families.evidence_boundary: Trend synthesis is a candidate signal until underlying observations and limits are checked.

families.role: public-company filings, strategy, operating constraints, financial claims, and burden transfer
families.trigger: new filing, earnings period, theme-map revision, or source-owner correction
families.access_basis: pinned repository revision or local source artifact
families.evidence_boundary: Company disclosures are reported claims; independently observed outcomes remain separate.

families.role: private-company growth, business models, and bottom-up market signals
families.cadence: annual release and quarterly evidence refresh
families.trigger: new ranking release, source-linked company evidence, or field-validation result
families.access_basis: pinned repository revision or local source artifact
families.evidence_boundary: Ranking and growth records are source-scoped; they do not prove peer identity, causality, or demand.

families.role: industry definitions, structures, forces, bottlenecks, capacity, and dependencies
families.trigger: new industry record, force register, finding, or falsifier
families.access_basis: pinned repository revision or local source artifact
families.evidence_boundary: Analytic synthesis; does not establish customer demand, prevalence, willingness to pay, or live customer outcomes.

families.role: capture, provenance, normalization, deduplication, verification, and connection infrastructure
families.trigger: new custody, deduplication, rights, or verification contract
families.access_basis: pinned repository revision or local source artifact
families.evidence_boundary: Provenance infrastructure does not itself establish a trend.

families.role: shared identity, evidence, comparability, review, rights, and release contracts
families.cadence: on identity, comparability, rights, or release-contract revision
families.trigger: governance contract changes the permitted bridge or review state
families.access_basis: pinned repository revision or local source artifact
families.evidence_boundary: Integration and governance layer; it must not rewrite source-owner conclusions.

boundary: Control fields preserve what must be reviewed. 'not_yet_verified' and 'review_required' do not establish rights, independence, or current availability.
